prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a serene Japanese garden with raked pale gravel, a stone path, a low wooden bridge with a waist-high rail and a standard-height wooden gate, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Romanian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm fair-olive skin, thick dark straight-edged brows, a heavy black liner smoked out at the outer corners, deep brown shadow blended up to the crease, long dense lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour, a deep red matte lip with a crisp edge, an intense, proud expression, sleek silver-grey hair styled in half-up, top section lifted with the length flowing loose below, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long bronze chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a lead teardrop-shaped sinker, a lead barrel-shaped weight, a copper cube-shaped block, a silver pyramid-shaped lump, a gold square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten mixed-metal anklets. LEFT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a white ruffled lace maid headband, a black lace choker with a small bow and white lace wrist cuffs, a tiny black satin micro-bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups on thin strings tied at the neck and back, fully covering her bust, and a minimal black satin micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.

RIGHT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a long black cape lined in red silk, fastened at her neck and hanging open down her back, leaving the front of her body bare, a tiny black satin micro-bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups on thin strings tied at the neck and back, fully covering her bust, and a minimal black satin micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
